segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers describe the serum as absorbing well and helping with clogged pores, texture, and reduced need for midday touch-ups, though one oily/dehydrated reviewer saw no results.
segments.dry: A dry, acne-prone reviewer reports no irritation and even skin tone from regular use, while another with dry skin found it still left her a bit dry compared to a previous product.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report reduced redness, balanced oil, and smoother texture with repeated repurchasing.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation and reduced redness even with daily use, but others describe stinging, itching, red bumps, or worsened rosacea, especially on first use.
segments.mature: One reviewer mentions reduced under-eye wrinkles alongside improved skin tone, but mature skin is barely represented in the reviews.

concerns.aging: Only one reviewer credits the serum with reducing under-eye wrinkles while blending skin tone; aging is otherwise not discussed.
concerns.dehydration: A few reviewers note dryness late in the day or general dryness persisting despite use, though most do not report the product as drying.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness report visible reduction, sometimes within days, including in rosacea; however, a subset report the opposite effect, with increased redness, red bumps, or rosacea flare-ups after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer states the product wrecked her skin barrier and caused inflammatory lesions on her cheeks; this is an isolated but serious report.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading of dark spots, post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, and acne scars, generally after several weeks to months of consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, particularly with hormonal or acne-prone skin, report breakouts clearing or staying away with continued use; a smaller number describe new or worsening breakouts, including cystic pimples, especially early on.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the product helps balance oil and reduces the need for touch-ups, with no reports of increased oiliness.

extraits.titre: Love the brand, hate this product
extraits.texte: Wanted to love this because I am a fan of the brand, however, this serum wrecked my skin barrier. After using for a week, I broke out in inflammatory lesions on my cheeks, a place I never have issues with. My goal was to reduce redness, this not only did not do that, it did me dirty. I think it's the niacinamide and strong vitamin C that together caused the perfect inflammatory storm. Might work for some, absolutely did not for me. Highly recommend patch testing before committing to your full face.

It interesting that this is for sensitive skin because it exacerbated my rosacea. Every time I use it it has the opposite effect of what it claims. I turn bright red and have red bumps for days afterwards. Very itchy. Vitamin C is not a good addition for sensitive skins. My skin doesn't ever adjust to it. I have seen no benefits. I saw that other reviewers mentioned a terrible smell, but to me it smelled like cinnamon. It seems like if you want good azelaic acid you might need to get a prescription. This doesn't cut it.

extraits.titre: What I use instead of Vitamin C
extraits.texte: I don't have sensitive skin but I do have dry, acne-prone skin. The one thing I do have a sensitivity to is Vitamin C. I get horrible cystic acne from it and I've tried every brand under the sun (including this one). I saw that you could use Azelaic Acid if you're intolerant to Vitamin C (who knows if that's true, I saw it on social media) but I can definitely say this doesn't irritate my skin and evens my skin tone. I'm actually on my 3rd bottle so I would say I recommend it. I don't have any issues with it under my makeup or anything like that.

This product is amazing. I didnt have high hopes at first but my mind is changed. I suffer from hormonal acne and i also have very sensitive, eczema prone skin and this product does not irritate me. On top of that, I've only used this for 2 days and my acne is already drying up!! I pair this product with a vitamin C from Vanicream for the am (i use Azelaic acid for the PM) and I am seeing results within 2 days of use. 10/10 (also a pregnancy safe product!)

I love this product. I was using a cream based Azelaic Acid and was not happy with the texture (and it ball up if I touched my face!). This serum is much more comfortable and absorbs more effectively. It has actually been more beneficial in reducing Rosacea flare ups then my prescription (and very expensive) cream! I alternate nights between this serum and a probiotic moisturizer. This has been the best combo for me in treating my Rosacea. Highly recommend!

This is the first Azelaic acid that has worked for me! Emollient versions seemed to cause breakouts, so I really appreciate the lighter, more watery texture of this one. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, and I wake up to much less redness in the morning. I have reacted badly to strong Vitamin C products, as well as Niacinamide, in the past. This formula contains both, but I've had no problems with it. It's great!

extraits.titre: The product I've been looking for!
extraits.texte: HOLY GRAIL. I've been using the Azelaic acid serum daily for about two weeks now. I pair it with the Niacinimide serum at night and use the Vitaminc C serum + Niacinimide serum during the day. All my hormonal breakouts have cleared, any flare ups I get from mask wearing subside within a day, and I've noticed significant fading in my dark spots. NOTE: I've built up to using actives daily. My skin trends sensitive & fairly combination with dryness around my cheeks/eyes and hormonal breakouts around my chin. If you have not used stronger, active acidic ingredients in skincare before, I highly recommend starting by using this product weekly and building up from there! You will not be disappointed.
